en.hubeali: From him, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Murazim Bin Hakeym,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Whenever you are intending with a goodness, so hasten, for you do not know what might occur’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Marazim ibn Hakim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
My father (a.s.) would say, ‘When you intend to perform a good deed, do not delay; you may not know what happens next.’”
